service.description: Keeps the active tenant's audit config as a new version when it changed since the latest one. Needs edit access to the tenant.

parameter.name: created
parameter.description: False when nothing changed; version is then the latest.

parameter.name: version
parameter.description: {id, seq, parentId, hash, bundleVersion, counts: {audits, statements, checks, runs, queries, conclusionCodes, connections}, changeSource, reason, createdBy, createdDate}

set.from: darpan.facade.common.TenantAccessSupport.requireActiveTenantWriteAccess(ec, 'Your active tenant only has view access, so it cannot keep a config version.')

service.description: The active tenant's config versions, newest first, without their packs.

parameter.name: versions
parameter.description: [{id, seq, parentId, hash, bundleVersion, counts, changeSource, createdByName, reason, createdBy, createdDate}]

service.description: One of the active tenant's config versions, with its pack (the whole-tenant transfer bundle).

What restoring one of the active tenant's config versions would do, writing nothing. What the version holds is put back; a statement added since is switched off and a check link added since removed; runs added since are kept. Pass planHash to restore#TenantConfigVersion to apply exactly this.

parameter.name: version
parameter.description: The version, as get#TenantConfigVersions lists it.

parameter.name: plan
parameter.description: {lines: [{kind, ref, label, action (CREATE | UPDATE | UNCHANGED | MAPPED), targetId, changes: [{field, from, to}]}], blocking: [{code, ref, message}], warnings: [{code, ref, message}], counts, switchOff: [{statementId, audit, statement}], unlink: [{statementId, checkId, audit, statement, check}], kept: [{kind, label}]}

parameter.name: planHash
parameter.description: SHA-256 of the version, the importer's plan and the switch-offs and unlinks.

service.description: Restores one of the active tenant's config versions by applying exactly the plan preview#TenantConfigRestore showed: the current config is kept as a version first ("Before restoring version N"), then the restore is written and kept as a version ("Restored version N"). One transaction: all of it or none of it. Needs edit access to the tenant.

parameter.name: planHash
parameter.description: The planHash of the preview being applied.

parameter.name: before
parameter.description: The version kept before the restore (the version itself when nothing changed since it).

parameter.name: after
parameter.description: The version the restore left (the same as before when the restore changed nothing).

parameter.name: plan
parameter.description: The plan applied, as preview#TenantConfigRestore answered it.

set.from: darpan.facade.common.TenantAccessSupport.requireActiveTenantWriteAccess(ec, 'Your active tenant only has view access, so it cannot restore a config version.')
